AI Video Editor ChatGPT 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Edit raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) using ChatGPT-style AI prompts.
- Seamless cloud-based processing; most edits complete in 1–2 minutes and export as 1080p MP4.
- Supports prompt-driven workflows: auto-trim, auto-caption, AI title cards, and more.
- Automatic setup with free credits for new users (via NEMO_TOKEN).
- Full session state, multiple file formats, and comprehensive status/error handling.
- Simple commands: upload, edit, preview, export, and check credits or session state.
